label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Lucas Herbert leads The Open
items.text: Lucas Herbert leads the 2026 Open Championship at Royal Birkdale with a final score of 8-under par, two shots ahead of Jackson Suber, Cameron Young and Ryan Gerard at 6-under.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau penalized at The Open
items.text: Bryson DeChambeau received a two-stroke penalty for improving his lie by tamping down grass in the fescue on the par-4 5th, dropping him from one shot off the lead to three shots back and triggering a heated argument with officials.

items.headline: Todd Clements tops Corales Puntacana
items.text: Todd Clements finished the Corales Puntacana Championship at 13-under par, leading Johannes Veerman, Ben James, and Gordon Sargent who all finished at 11-under.
